### Contributor checklist

- [ ] I read `AGENTS.md`, `progress/hotd1.json`, and `docs/MODEL2C_DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md`.
- [ ] I updated the tracked estimate **or** appended an unchanged-percentage `review` entry with evidence.
- [ ] I kept past progress history entries unchanged and ran `python -m arcaderecomp.progress validate`.
- [ ] I ran `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` (or noted why not), and checked CI.
- [ ] I did not commit copyrighted ROM bytes, ROM-derived generated game code, or fabricated Sega hardware replies.
